I have updated the dimensions of the main deck windows in `plane.js` by reducing their height, width, and thickness to match the human-curated design reference (`0.71 x 0.4 x 0.05`). This change transforms them from thick, indistinct stripes into more clearly defined individual panes with visible spacing between them, directly addressing the "Window and door lines" critique while maintaining the established window count and position.

**Visible Difference:** From profile views (e.g., view 1, view 8), the passenger window line will appear significantly sharper and more realistic, as each pane will have a distinct presence rather than blending into a solid dark band on the fuselage surface.
**Lines Changed:** Only one line within the main deck window loop was modified; no other parts of the file were touched.
**Execution Status:** The file remains a self-contained ES module and maintains its original export signature.
